pageTitle: How to launch Naura Meets in your community
metaDescription: Admin guide: create a room, announce it, pin the link, and optionally enable automatic invites via the bot.

hero.title: How to launch Naura Meets in your community

s1.title: Create a room
s1.body: To run meetings in Naura Meets, create your community room using the link from your manager. The wizard has 4 steps:

substeps.title: Community template
substeps.body: Pick a template or keep “Classic Random Coffee” — a weekly 1:1 match inside your community. Other templates include Business Networking (investors ↔ project creators) and Mentorship (mentors ↔ mentees). If you are unsure, use classic Random Coffee.

substeps.title: Community name
substeps.body: Choose a name for the room. This is how it will appear to members in the bot — keep it short and recognizable, the same way people already refer to your community.

substeps.title: Language
substeps.body: Default language for notifications: the bot uses it for member messages (invites, reminders). Pick the language of most of your audience — for example Russian or English. This is not the admin UI language; it is the language people receive.

substeps.title: Event schedule
substeps.body: Set the weekly cycle: day and time for events like Opt-In Reminder, Matching, and Contact Reminder. You can keep the defaults and change them later under the Schedule tab.

s1.afterBody: On the community screen, tap “Copy link” or “Share”. Post that link in your channel or group so members can register and join meetings.

s2.title: Publish an announcement
s2.body: Post the room link in your community. Subscribers or group members use it to register and join meetings with each other.
s2.extra: Inside the service, people can also meet members of other communities: there are rooms in Russian and English, and rooms by interest.

s3.title: Pin the link
s3.body: One announcement is often not enough: some people will see it later, and new members will arrive after launch.
bullets: Pin the post with the room link at the top of the channel or group.
If your community has a useful-resources list, add the link there.
You can also post the link with other useful materials in comments under new posts.
s3.exampleLead: A simple way to keep the room link next to other community resources:
s3.exampleCopyHint: Copy and paste into a Telegram comment. Replace {room link} with your room link.
s3.exampleCopyText:
**Useful:**
📖 Channel index — all posts by topic
☕️ {room link} — random coffee for readers
🎁 @naura_benefits_bot — tools and finds
🤝 Naura Meets — channel about introductions and networking

announcements.title: Announcement examples
announcements.lead: Replace {room link} with your room link. If the text includes {community name}, put your Naura Meets room name there.

items.label: Main announcement — how it works
items.text:
In “{community name}” we’re launching Naura Meets — 1:1 introductions inside our community.

It’s very simple:

1/ Fill in a short profile in the bot:
{room link}

2/ Once a week the bot suggests a good match from our community

3/ After that it’s up to you: hop on a call, meet offline for coffee, or just talk

...
PROFIT!

Participation is optional. Join the intros in “{community name}”!

items.label: Lively chat announcement
items.text:
There are so many interesting people in this chat — and almost nobody messages first 😅

So we are connecting Naura Meets: once a week the bot introduces you to one person from the community. A short 1-on-1 — online or over coffee, whatever works.

How to join:
1) open the link and activate the bot
2) fill in a short profile
3) choose the community “{community name}”

Then every week you get a new reason to meet someone.

{room link}

items.label: Short channel post
items.text:
Meeting people in our community just got easier: once a week Naura Meets matches you with someone from the group.

You choose the format — a call, coffee, or a short chat. Optional, no pressure.

Start here:
{room link}

items.label: About people nearby
items.text:
Sometimes the best part of a community is not another post — it is one real conversation with someone inside it.

We are launching Naura Meets: every week the bot introduces you to someone from “{community name}”. No cold DMs — just a clear reason to start talking.

Join:
{room link}

items.label: For long-time chat lurkers
items.text:
You have been reading the chat for a while, you know the names… and you still barely know anyone in person?

Fair. That is why we added Naura Meets — once a week, one new person from the community for a short 1-on-1.

The profile takes a couple of minutes:
{room link}

items.label: Useful, without the corporate tone
items.text:
A new contact, a project idea, work advice, or just a good conversation — these usually start with one introduction, not another feed post.

Naura Meets suggests one person from our community each week. Then you decide: call, coffee, or chat.

Jump in:
{room link}

items.label: Light Friday tone
items.text:
Friday experiment ☕

What if next week you already had a new acquaintance from our community?

Naura Meets keeps it simple: short profile → one match a week → you choose how to continue.

Who is in:
{room link}

items.label: For community newcomers
items.text:
Just joined and not sure who to talk to first?

In “{community name}” we use Naura Meets: the bot gently introduces members one-on-one, so you can start conversations without feeling like you are messaging into the void.

Start here:
{room link}

bot.title: Automatic invites
bot.leadAfter: to the group. Then the bot can publish a weekly invite to join Naura Meets.
steps: Add @CoffeeMeetBot to the group, or make it an admin if posting requires permissions.
In the mini app, open broadcast settings.
Choose the event type: message to the group.
Paste the group ID and enable the event.
bot.userInfoNote: How to find the group ID
bot.userInfoHintBefore: Forward any message from the group to
bot.userInfoHintAfter: — it will show the chat id. You need the numeric group ID; it usually starts with a minus sign.

messageExamples.label: Weekly invite
messageExamples.text:
This week you can meet someone from our community again.

Open Naura Meets and confirm — the bot will match you with a person for a short 1-on-1 conversation.

messageExamples.label: Soft reminder
messageExamples.text:
Want a match this week? Confirm in Naura Meets.

Busy week? Skip the round — there will be another chance next time.

messageExamples.label: For newcomers
messageExamples.text:
New here? We use Naura Meets — once a week you can meet someone from the community one-on-one.

Participation is optional. Start by confirming in @CoffeeMeetBot.
